stock.description: Dowell Service Group Co. Limited, an investment holding company, provides property management and value-added services in the People's Republic of China. The company offers city operations services to residential and non-residential properties, including security, cleaning, gardening, facility management, and maintenance services to foreign-related projects, including services to foreign-owned enterprises, foreign embassies, and international schools. It also provides lifestyle services, such as community events planning services; management and agency services, such as car parking spaces management, car parking spaces and property sales, property leasing, and public resources management services; utility maintenance services; and renovation management and decoration services. In addition, the company offers sales assistance services comprising cleaning, security, maintenance of display units, visitor management, and hospitality services; preliminary planning and delivery assistance services, such as pre-delivery consultancy and inspection services; digital and intelligent technology services; maintenance and rectification services; comprehensive health services, including home visit care and facility-based elderly care services; and other related comprehensive value-added services. Further, it provides real estate marketing, e-commerce, construction engineering consultancy, culture development, community service, information technology, property management, and enterprise and hospital management services. The company serves property owners and developers, residents, and enterprises. The company was formerly known as Chongqing Dongyuan Renzhi Industrial Co., Ltd and changed its name to Dowell Service Group Co. Limited in December 2020. Dowell Service Group Co. Limited was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Chongqing, China.
